evals.prompt: 幫我 review 一下我在 Jacky/develop 這個 branch 上的改動，跟 develop 比較，看看有沒有什麼問題，我等一下要開 PR。
evals.expected_output: A structured code review report comparing current branch changes to develop, checking naming conventions, file placement, architecture patterns, Kotlin quality rules, and commit messages. Should include severity-tiered issues table and a PR readiness verdict.

assertions.text: Output contains a severity-tiered issues section (e.g. BLOCKER/CRITICAL, MAJOR, MINOR headers or a table with severity levels)
Output ends with a clear PR readiness verdict — one of: 'Ready for PR', 'Fix before PR', or 'Not ready'
Output reviews at least one named Kotlin file from the diff (e.g. AccountManager.kt, MyClassWindow.kt, SelectOrgWindow.kt)
Output checks architecture rules (e.g. MVVM, Manager/ViewModel/Window layer boundaries)
Output checks naming conventions (class names, XML IDs, layout names, or similar)
Output includes a commit message review section or mentions commit format
Output mentions SonarCloud or Kotlin code quality rules (cognitive complexity, nesting depth, var/val, etc.)

evals.expected_output: Code review focused on the changed files. Should check Manager class patterns (singleton, Koin injection), Window architecture rules (business logic not in view layer), and all naming/placement conventions. Issues table plus readiness verdict.
